title: Programming exercises with a RAG question-answering tutor
summary: Students work on programming-domain learning tasks in a web-based intelligent tutoring system and ask a mentor-like question-answering system for help. The system combines a large language model with retrieval-augmented generation to ground live responses in selected learning content.
